title: Strategies Around the Investor
primary_theme: LP diligence on emerging managers through strategy-person fit
founder_lessons: Build a fund strategy around what is genuinely special about the manager, not around generic market fashion.
Take time in Fund 1 to see deals and learn before deploying too quickly.
Track follow-on decisions contemporaneously so future fundraising claims are evidence-backed.
Avoid growing too big too fast when fund size, reserves, and ownership needs are not aligned.
notable_quotes: People who build strategies around what is so special about them.
First is if you're on a fund 1, take your time getting started.
just be careful about growing too big, too fast.
